summary: TFS Financial Corp filed an 8-K announcing a $0.2825/share cash dividend payable June 24, 2026 to holders of record June 10, 2026. The MHC, owning 81% of shares, has waived its dividend right for this and prior quarters through July 8, 2026, per member and Fed approval. The board also reduced its size from 12 to 11 after director Meredith Weil retired. This is a pure capital return event; structural overhang from MHC control remains. Watch for continued dividend waivers as a quasi-buyback signal.
